items.question: Who blesses and grants the wish?
items.inference: The goddess blesses him and grants his wish.

items.question: Where does he dwell with sovereignty?
premises: He is endowed with all sovereignty.
items.inference: He dwells in your world endowed with all sovereignty.
uncertainties: tava loke is treated as one token despite internal space.

items.question: What rites follow rising at brahma-muhurta?
items.inference: After rising at brahma-muhurta, one bathes and worships twilight.
uncertainties: brāhme muhūrtte is treated as one token despite internal space.
items.plain_english: Rising at brahma-muhurta, one bathes and worships twilight.

items.question: Who adorns oneself with incense and flowers?
premises: The adornment uses incense and flowers.

items.question: When is the chosen deity worshipped?
premises: The chosen deity is worshipped in its circle.
